Bancroft.conditions: By-law 49-2015 (passed June 23, 2015; replaced the ATV-only 01-2004): 'Off-Road Vehicles shall be permitted on all roads and highways under the jurisdiction of the Town of Bancroft', covering ATVs incl. two-up, MOHUVs (UTVs) and ROVs (side-by-sides). Must meet O. Reg. 316/03 ss.7-15 equipment and ss.16-24 operating rules. Speed 20 km/h where posted 50 or less, 50 km/h where posted over 50. No season or hour limits in the text. By-law 43-2020 (Aug 11, 2020) amends 49-2015 by adding definitions of extreme terrain vehicles and off-road motorcycles; it adds no separate operative clause, but because 49-2015 permits 'Off-Road Vehicles' generally, the town treats ETVs and dirt bikes as included (local news reports council approving that). Hwy 28/62 in town are provincial, not covered by the by-law. Bancroft is a town and is NOT in O. Reg. 8/03, so only the by-law permits road riding. No newer ORV by-law found in Bancroft's 2021-2026 by-law folders.
Bancroft.bylaw: 49-2015, amended by 43-2020 (01-2004 was the original ATV-only by-law)

Hastings Highlands.conditions: No ORV by-law (permitting or prohibiting) is on the municipality's by-laws page (checked 2026-11-14; its traffic by-law 2020-009 was listed but could not be downloaded). Hastings Highlands IS in the O. Reg. 8/03 Table (confirmed on e-Laws), so under O. Reg. 316/03 s.4.1(2) ATVs, UTVs, side-by-sides, ETVs and off-road motorcycles that meet Part III may use municipal roads by default since Jan 1, 2021. Provincial 20/50 km/h limits apply. Includes Maynooth, Lake St. Peter, Birds Creek. Hwy 62/127/28 segments are provincial.
Hastings Highlands.bylaw: none found (default under O. Reg. 8/03 / 316/03 s.4.1(2))

Faraday.conditions: By-law 25-2015 (passed July 8, 2015) permits MOHUVs, ROVs, ATVs (incl. two-up) and 'Off-Road Vehicles' on all highways under township jurisdiction, with no road schedule, season or hour limits. Must meet O. Reg. 316/03 ss.7-15 (equipment), 16-18 (permit, insurance, licence), s.19 (helmet) and ss.20-24 (operation). Speed 20 km/h where posted 50 or less, 50 km/h where over 50. It does not name ETVs or off-road motorcycles, but Faraday is in O. Reg. 8/03, so those are allowed by default. Unopened road allowances need written council approval (By-law 21-2024, passed Apr 3, 2024). The township's site lists the PDF as 'ATV By-Law'.

Wollaston.conditions: By-law 05-2021 (filed as 2021-0005, passed Jan 11, 2021) permits ATVs, ETVs, MOHUVs, off-road motorcycles and ROVs on highways under township jurisdiction, subject to O. Reg. 316/03 equipment and operating rules. Excluded: sidewalks and footpaths; municipal parks and beaches; private roads or driveways without the owner's consent; provincial highways; roads where passage is restricted under Municipal Act s.35; and unopened road allowances. No season, hour or township speed limits beyond the provincial ones. Repeals all earlier ORV by-laws. The Wollaston Rail Trail (township-owned multi-use trail) needs an OFATV, EOTA, KATVA or HATVA pass. Includes Coe Hill.

Limerick.conditions: No ORV road by-law appears in the township's online by-law and media library (searched 2026-11-14 for ATV, off-road, ORV, trail). Limerick IS in O. Reg. 8/03 (confirmed), so ORVs meeting Part III are allowed on municipal roads by default since 2021 unless a by-law prohibits them; none found. By-law 2025-04 (Feb 19, 2025) authorizes an agreement with the Coe Hill ATV Club (trail use, not road rules; the agreement text was not in the agenda extract). Note: limerick.ca's media library may not hold older by-laws, so an unlisted by-law can't be ruled out.
Limerick.bylaw: none found for roads (default under 8/03); 2025-04 = ATV club agreement

Tudor and Cashel.conditions: By-law 2015-22 (passed July 7, 2015) permits MOHUVs, ROVs, ATVs (incl. two-up) and ORVs on all highways under township jurisdiction, with no road schedule or hour limits. Same wording as Faraday 25-2015: O. Reg. 316/03 equipment, permit, insurance, licence, helmet and operation rules. Speed 20 km/h where posted 50 or less, 50 km/h where over 50. ETVs and dirt bikes are not named, but the township is in 8/03, so they are allowed by default. Unopened road allowances: no use without written council approval (Policy By-law 2023-34). No later ORV amendment found in the township's media library.

Carlow/Mayo.conditions: By-law 21-2015 (passed July 14, 2015) amends By-law 28-2004. It permits MOHUVs, ROVs, ATVs and ORVs on all highways under township jurisdiction, under the same O. Reg. 316/03 conditions and the same 20/50 km/h limits as Faraday and Tudor and Cashel. No road schedule or hour limits. The township is in 8/03, so ETVs and dirt bikes are allowed by default.

Marmora and Lake.conditions: An ATV by-law (2004-10 as amended by 2015-31) was reported in the earlier pass but not confirmed this time; a 2026 search snippet of marmoraandlake.ca/bylaw showed no ATV entry. Marmora and Lake IS in O. Reg. 8/03 (confirmed), so ORVs are allowed on its roads by default unless a by-law prohibits or limits them. Crowe Valley CA barricaded the EOTA trail ramp into Callaghan's Rapids CA (2022).

Madoc (Township).conditions: No ORV by-law found. 'Madoc' IS in the O. Reg. 8/03 Table (the township; Madoc village is in Centre Hastings), so ORVs are allowed on township roads by default unless prohibited.

Centre Hastings.conditions: No ORV by-law found. Centre Hastings IS in O. Reg. 8/03 (confirmed), so ORVs are allowed on municipal roads by default unless prohibited. A by-law limiting the Madoc village core is possible but none was found. The municipal trail network (22 km) is promoted for ATVs.

Tweed.conditions: Earlier pass: By-law 2017-16 regulates ORVs on municipal highways. An old forum post cites By-law 2004-14 for ATVs on Tweed roads. Neither text was seen. Tweed IS in O. Reg. 8/03 (confirmed), so the default is open unless the by-law restricts. Any by-law restrictions (for example in Tweed village) are unknown.

Highlands East.conditions: By-law 2020-67: municipal roads open to ORVs under O. Reg. 316/03 and the ORV Act, with ss.7-15 (equipment) and 16-24 (operation) applying. Speed 20/50 km/h. Off-road motorcycles and Argo-type vehicles were added in 2020. The municipal by-laws page (checked 2026-11-14) still links an 'Off Road Vehicle By-law' (civicweb doc 422407), but that PDF host is blocked here, so the text was not re-read. Highlands East IS in O. Reg. 8/03 (confirmed), so roads are open by default anyway. Includes Wilberforce, Gooderham, Cardiff, Tory Hill.

Dysart et al.conditions: No ORV road by-law found (only snowmobile By-law 2020-11 and Head Lake Park By-law 2023-04). Dysart et al IS in O. Reg. 8/03 (confirmed), so the default allows ORVs on municipal roads unless prohibited. Haliburton County roads follow the County rules (see County of Haliburton). The Haliburton County Rail Trail is permit-only (HATVA/KATVA), May 1 - Nov 30; a 2016 Minden Times story said ORVs were banned from it, so check the current status.

Minden Hills.conditions: A Highlander article (Dec 30, 2020) reports Minden Hills moving to allow more ORV types (ETVs, dirt bikes), which implies an ORV road by-law exists; number not found. Minden Hills IS in O. Reg. 8/03 (confirmed), so roads are open by default. The township funded a HATVA trail link into Minden.
Minden Hills.bylaw: exists per 2020 news; number not found

Algonquin Highlands.conditions: By-law 2020-73: ATVs, ROVs, MOHUVs, wheeled ETVs and off-road motorcycles allowed on all municipal roads (the title refers to the shoulder). Tracked ETVs not allowed. Speed 20/50 km/h. Listed in 8/03. Hwy 60 in this township (Algonquin Park corridor) is Schedule A.

Madawaska Valley.conditions: No ORV road by-law found. Madawaska Valley IS in O. Reg. 8/03 (confirmed), so the default allows ORVs on township roads unless prohibited. An MOU and land use agreement with the Renfrew County ATV Club cover the municipally owned rail trail. County of Renfrew roads: see County. Includes Barry's Bay, Combermere.

South Algonquin.conditions: By-law 2023-760 (passed July 5, 2023) regulates ATVs, ETVs and off-road motorcycles on municipal highways by applying O. Reg. 316/03 (per a search summary of the PDF; no road schedule reported). A township newsletter advises not riding roads posted over 50 km/h. By-law 2023-777 bans ATVs on sidewalks, parks and township property without CAO consent. South Algonquin IS in O. Reg. 8/03 (confirmed). Includes Whitney, Madawaska.

Killaloe, Hagarty and Richards.conditions: No ORV by-law found (only By-law 19-2025 on unopened road allowances, which needs checking before riding allowances). The township IS in O. Reg. 8/03 (confirmed), so roads are open by default unless prohibited. County of Renfrew roads: see County.

Bonnechere Valley.conditions: By-law 2020-049 'regulates the operation of all-terrain vehicles on municipal highways' (title confirmed on the township's by-law page via search); roads and hours not seen. The ATV club has a railbed agreement. Listed in O. Reg. 8/03 (confirmed). Includes Eganville. Don't confuse it with Tay Valley's own By-law 2020-049.

Brudenell, Lyndoch and Raglan.conditions: No ORV by-law found. The township IS in O. Reg. 8/03 (the Table spells it 'Brudenell, Lynoch and Raglan'), so roads are open by default unless prohibited.

Greater Madawaska.conditions: By-law 71-2020 regulates ORVs on municipal roads (citing s.4.1 of 316/03); road list not seen. Listed in O. Reg. 8/03 (confirmed), so the default is open where the by-law does not restrict. Seasonally maintained roads are covered by By-law 33-2025. Includes Calabogie, Griffith.

North Algona Wilberforce.conditions: No ORV by-law found. The township IS in O. Reg. 8/03 (listed as 'North Algona-Wilberforce'), so roads are open by default unless prohibited. County of Renfrew roads: see County.

Addington Highlands.conditions: 2004 by-law (Frontenac News; number not found) allowed ATVs on township roads and road portions listed in a schedule. Current version unknown. Addington Highlands IS in O. Reg. 8/03 (confirmed), so since 2021 ORVs are allowed on all township roads by default unless a by-law prohibits; whether the old schedule still restricts anything is unknown. L&A County roads: County By-law 3316/15 as amended by 3326/16 and 3493/21 now permits ORVs on all County highways EXCEPT the roads in Schedule A (map updated Nov 2022). Includes Denbigh, Cloyne, Flinton, Northbrook.

North Frontenac.conditions: 2005 by-law: 4-wheeled ATVs on township roads or portions listed in a schedule, 6:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m. Permits sold around 2008-09. North Frontenac IS in O. Reg. 8/03 (confirmed), so the default since 2021 is open unless restricted, though the 2005 hours/schedule may still apply if that by-law is in force. No 2022 replacement found.

Central Frontenac.conditions: 2006 by-law: licensed, insured, single-seat 4-wheel ATVs on all municipal roads. Current version unknown (may since include more vehicle types). The K&P Trail is a Frontenac County trail (By-law 2022-0033).

Havelock-Belmont-Methuen.conditions: Off-Road Vehicles By-law 2024-024 (the township's ORV by-law, not only an AMP by-law as the earlier pass said) governs township roads. Township notice: ATV/ORV access to township roadways is prohibited Dec 1 - Mar 31; otherwise riders are welcome on township roads following township by-laws and the HTA. Banned year-round on sidewalks, driveways, private land, unopened road allowances, Mathison Conservation Area and municipal parks. HBM IS in O. Reg. 8/03 (confirmed). Peterborough County roads in HBM: 11 listed sections only (County schedule).

North Kawartha.conditions: ATV By-law 2021-0026 with Schedule A road map allows ATVs on township roads and rescinds 2017-109. A separate 'ORV by-law and repeal ATV by-law' PDF exists (number and date not seen), and the township page still cites 2021-0026. An older 2016-35a 'ORV schedule of permitted road' also exists. CONTRADICTION on county roads: the township page says the County has no by-law opening County roads in North Kawartha, but Peterborough County amendments list NK sections (2023-21 lists CR 504; 2023-47 lists CR 46). Treat County roads in NK as unknown and check orv_map_oct2023. Hwy 28 north of CR 504 is Schedule A. North Kawartha IS in O. Reg. 8/03 (confirmed). Includes Apsley.
North Kawartha.bylaw: 2021-0026 (possibly superseded by a newer ORV by-law)

Trent Lakes.conditions: The Peterborough County ORV page links a 'Municipality of Trent Lakes - Off Road Vehicle Bylaw' (number not seen). A 2021 KATVA map says ATVs, side-by-sides and dirt bikes are allowed on all municipal roads in Trent Lakes, with passengers 8+. The O. Reg. 8/03 Table lists Trent Lakes' former name 'Galway-Cavendish and Harvey' (renamed 2013), so the default probably applies, but that is unverified. County roads in Trent Lakes: only listed segments of CR 36, 37, 503, 507.

City of Kawartha Lakes.conditions: ATVs and side-by-sides only on roads the City has designated (yellow ATV-symbol signs). The ATV pilot was made permanent at the Mar 19, 2024 council meeting. No ATVs on Lindsay streets. Dirt bikes not permitted on any City road. Pilot-era terms (may have changed): 7:00 a.m. - 9:30 p.m., KATVA (or affiliate) membership, G2/M2, plate, insurance. Municipal trails closed until May 1 (OPP 2026). Not in O. Reg. 8/03 (confirmed), so there is no default access.

Admaston/Bromley.conditions: No ORV by-law found on the township's by-law page. Listed in O. Reg. 8/03, so ORVs are allowed on municipal roads by default unless prohibited.

Lake of Bays.conditions: By-law 2016-041: ORVs permitted on all municipal highways EXCEPT the roads in Schedule A (the snippet was cut off after 'East Walker Lake Drive'; get the full list from the PDF). Operating conditions are in the by-law.

Stirling-Rawdon.conditions: No ORV by-law found. Stirling-Rawdon IS in O. Reg. 8/03 (confirmed), so roads are open by default unless prohibited.

Tyendinaga.conditions: Only the northern edge is in the bbox. Not researched for a by-law. Tyendinaga IS in O. Reg. 8/03 (confirmed), so roads are open by default unless prohibited.

Asphodel-Norwood.conditions: By-law 2022-56: ORVs on municipal roads only to link riders to approved trails; not permitted 9:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. Asphodel-Norwood is in O. Reg. 8/03 (confirmed), but per 316/03 s.4.1(3) the by-law's restrictions still apply.

County of Peterborough (county roads).conditions: ORV By-law 2022-61, Schedule A replaced by 2023-21 and then 2023-47 (2023-47a). Only the listed County Road sections are open (e.g. CR 36, 37, 503, 507 in Trent Lakes; 11 sections in HBM incl. CR 6 and 30). CONTRADICTION: the earlier pass said none in North Kawartha, but 2023-21 lists CR 504 sections and 2023-47 lists CR 46 in NK; the NK township page says none. Use orv_map_oct2023 to settle it. Reviewed every two years.

County of Haliburton (county roads).conditions: Minden Times (c. Sept 2020): ATVs, two-ups, side-by-sides and UTVs were already permitted on Haliburton County roads, and the county added ETVs (Argos) and off-road motorcycles. By-law number not found (3709 unconfirmed). County roads include CR 21, 503, 648, 121 and others. The OPP note that township by-laws don't open county roads applies here; it is the county by-law that opens them.

County of Renfrew (county roads).conditions: By-law 91-24 'to regulate the operation of off-road vehicles on County of Renfrew roads' (title confirmed). Earlier pass: ORVs may use County roads if they meet O. Reg. 316/03. CONTRADICTION: Arnprior and the County by-law listing still cite 7-21 as amended by 56-23. 91-24 is presumably the newer one, but whether it replaced 7-21 is unconfirmed. Some towns (Petawawa, Arnprior) designate routes only.

County of Lennox and Addington (county r.conditions: County ORV By-law 3316/15, amended by 3326/16 and 3493/21: ORVs permitted on all County highways in Addington Highlands, Loyalist, Greater Napanee and Stone Mills EXCEPT the sections listed in Schedule A (restricted-sections map updated Nov 2022).

County of Hastings (county roads).conditions: Hastings County appears to have no county road system: a 2020 Frontenac News column comparing counties says all comparators have county road systems 'except for Hastings County'. Numbered 'Hastings County Roads' (e.g. 62, 620) are owned by the lower tiers, so the router should apply the lower-tier municipality's rule. No county ORV by-law found. The county civicweb portal was reachable, but its search is JS-only and returned nothing usable.

County of Frontenac.conditions: Frontenac County is not known to own roads. The K&P Trail (County) allows ORVs with valid ORV Act permits under By-law 2022-0033; dirt bikes may be restricted (unverified forum claim).

permit_trail_systems.name: EOTA network incl. Hastings Heritage Trail (Glen Ross to Lake St. Peter, ~156 km, via Marmora, Bancroft)
permit_trail_systems.permit: EOTA trail pass ('OnePass'); Destination Ontario lists 'OnePass EOTA, OFATV'
permit_trail_systems.notes: Undated prices: about $150/yr, $75/week, $20/day; check current. Sold at Limerick Lake Lodge and 20+ outlets. EOTA's map has shown some trails its pass does not cover, which need an OFATV pass or no pass. The Park to Park trail joined the EOTA OnePass.

permit_trail_systems.name: Coe Hill Riders ATV Club (Wollaston Rail Trail, Limerick-area trails)
permit_trail_systems.permit: Trail access pass from OFATV, EOTA, KATVA or HATVA (Wollaston By-law 2021-0005); signs say a trail permit is required
permit_trail_systems.notes: Lease of the Wollaston Rail Trail extended to Feb 1, 2029 (2024 draft minutes). Limerick has club agreements (e.g. By-law 2025-04).

permit_trail_systems.name: HATVA - Haliburton ATV Association (1,700+ km) incl. Haliburton County Rail Trail
permit_trail_systems.permit: HATVA pass (KATVA pass also accepted on the Rail Trail)
permit_trail_systems.notes: Rail Trail motorized season May 1 - Nov 30. Lake of Bays ATV Club honours HATVA permits and sells day passes (~$20/day, $30/2 days).

permit_trail_systems.name: KATVA - Kawartha ATV Association (Kawartha Lakes / Victoria Rail Trail area)
permit_trail_systems.notes: Accepted on the Haliburton County Rail Trail.

permit_trail_systems.name: Renfrew County recreational trails (Algonquin Trail / Ottawa Valley Recreational Trail, K&P Trail in Renfrew County)
permit_trail_systems.permit: OFATV permit via getapermit.ofatv.org, choosing Renfrew County ATV Club (RCATV)
permit_trail_systems.notes: County By-law 139-24 (trail use; also 81-24). ATVs allowed May 1 - Nov 30. Older news saying ATVs ride free in Renfrew County is out of date.

permit_trail_systems.name: Haliburton Forest (private)
permit_trail_systems.permit: Haliburton Forest day/season permit (e.g. ~$52/day per driver + HST)
permit_trail_systems.notes: Private trail system, separate from HATVA.

permit_trail_systems.name: OFATV QuadON network (general)
permit_trail_systems.notes: Province-wide club network. Check which club covers which trail.

permit_trail_systems.name: Frontenac K&P Trail (Frontenac County)
permit_trail_systems.permit: Unclear; county by-law requires ORVs to hold valid ORV Act permits (vehicle permit). Whether a trail pass is required is unverified.
